title: Safer inference, recovery, and release qualification
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7 hardens model and recipe operations, separates privileged host actions, improves Spark recovery, and adds exact-commit local qualification for AMD64 and ARM64 releases.
changes: Make model and recipe preparation durable, abortable, restart-safe, and truthful when activation or rollback fails.
Keep the stable Cloudless API identity while validating managed engines, custom engines, local recipes, and distributed Spark launches before promotion.
Separate container, engine, desktop, power, network, and other privileged operations into narrowly scoped services instead of running the Cloudless daemon as root.
Protect Spark enrollment, Hugging Face, Research, and reviewed recipe credentials from frontend state, logs, support bundles, and release evidence.
Add guided physical qualification for boot, display, locale, keyboard, browser, terminal, update, rollback, encrypted restore, and one-/two-Spark failure recovery.
Replace paid hosted GitHub Actions with a local exact-commit qualification runner that retains hashed package, visual, and lifecycle evidence for both architectures.
Harden signed release publication with security readiness, trust inventory, SBOM, atomic R2 verification, beta soak, byte-identical stable promotion, and channel-isolated rollback artifacts.
Classify one- and two-Spark configurations as supported qualification targets while keeping three-to-eight-Spark orchestration explicitly preview until physical hardware is available.
